attestation_limits: Checkpoint, tokenizer, quantization, launch arguments and container are operator attestations; endpoint labels do not verify loaded artifacts.
This validator checks recorded evidence and cannot authenticate the physical origin of a bundle.
No per-request GPU energy or server token-generation timestamps are inferred.
Observed compute PID residency is matched to operator-declared worker PIDs; serving roles and loaded checkpoint identity remain attestations.
telemetry_threshold_scope: Polling, gap/read and timeout settings are operator-selected acceptance limits, not objective sensor accuracy, latency or measurement-completeness guarantees.

metrics.token_proxy_warning: (last content receipt - first content receipt)/(server completion_tokens - 1), not measured individual token times; stream chunks can contain multiple tokens.

total_energy_consistency_screen.scope: Full TOTAL window only, per selected GPU, for this resident-compute collection contract.
total_energy_consistency_screen.rule: Positive selected energy and power integral; when available, positive counter energy with absolute counter-power difference <= max(1 J, 20% of power integral).
total_energy_consistency_screen.interpretation: Fixed conservative data-quality screen; not a calibration, sensor-error bound or statistical confidence guarantee.

gpu_worker_residency.scope: Exact observed compute PID sets across the TOTAL window, including both idle phases and workload/completion/drain; process-to-serving-role and checkpoint associations remain operator attestations.

idle_before.power_warning: NVML power may be averaged over a one-second hardware interval; dense polling does not establish instantaneous power. Energy is selected GPU-board energy, not whole-server/facility energy or per-request attribution.
idle_before.boundary_method: linear interpolation within observed midpoint brackets
idle_before.scope: selected GPU boards only; no per-request attribution

energy.phase_accounting_note: Phase/idle estimates are diagnostics, not separately validated by the TOTAL consistency screen; counter update granularity can shift energy across phase boundaries.

readiness_reason: Synthetic fixtures cannot establish measured-data readiness.
